Choose epsilon0/1 through the actual auxiliary-prime projection, derive a least positive cardinality coprime to every prime power, and lift the remaining target using canonical natural division. Compose with the explicit affine-coordinate injection to construct a distinct finite subset with the prescribed target sum and exact size0<a<C0. Preserve C0 composite, exponent0 and T=1 helper controls. Record four fresh bounded author and isolated independent replays, byte-identical objects and four standard-only axiom audits. Leave actual power-orbit identification, safe positions and rank correction explicit.

Prove constructed copy masks, stronger word bounds and the complete physical ordering

Derive nine temporal copies, eight spatial copies and the signed marker source from actual marked matching and the same constructed carry normalization. Prove exact2009/2010 kernel fields and resets, F<q/radix and the exclusive C prefix bound. Check all941 non-Start coefficients in bounded blocks, derive full942 coverage and bind every cached position to the actual printed floor rank generically. Record root full-source review, fresh bounded copy replay, isolated independent top/data/order replays,46 standard-only audits and byte-identical objects. Preserve zero-stride/N=1 interfaces and keep padding/origin, actual K residues, controller and polynomial converse open.

Merge origin/main research packet placement before high-mask construction

Incoming 2026-10-26w placement and new incoming archives are inert research material. Confirmed no maintained Lean, tools, equation or toolchain delta. Preserve reviewed controller subset, copy-mask, stronger-bound and physical-order checkpoints.

+import DiophantineConsistency.ControllerOrbitTransport
+import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
+
+/-!
+# Choosing the auxiliary Boolean bit and a coprime subset cardinality
+
+The projection to a prime modulus is actual modular arithmetic. The bit
+and least positive cardinality are constructed, not supplied. Actual
+power-orbit coordinates and safe dummy positions remain separate.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.ControllerAuxiliaryChoice
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Two translates by a nonzero element cannot both vanish. -/
+theorem exists_boolean_sub_ne_zero {A : Type*} [AddGroup A]
+    (t b : A) (hb : b ≠ 0) : ∃ e : ℕ, e ≤ 1 ∧ t-e • b ≠ 0 := by
+  by_cases ht : t = 0
+  · refine ⟨1,by omega,?_⟩
+    simpa only [one_nsmul,ht,zero_sub,neg_ne_zero] using hb
+  · exact ⟨0,by omega,by simpa only [zero_nsmul,sub_zero] using ht⟩
+
+/-- The actual residue after the Boolean choice has a least representative
+strictly between0 andC0, coprime to every power of the auxiliary prime. -/
+theorem exists_coprime_cardinality {p C0 : ℕ} [NeZero C0]
+    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hdiv : p ∣ C0) (t b : ZMod C0)
+    (hb : ZMod.castHom hdiv (ZMod p) b ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
+    ∃ e a : ℕ, e ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < a ∧ a < C0 ∧
+      (a : ZMod C0) = t-(e : ZMod C0)*b ∧ Nat.Coprime a (p^n) := by
+  let phi : ZMod C0 →+* ZMod p := ZMod.castHom hdiv (ZMod p)
+  obtain ⟨e,he,hne⟩ := exists_boolean_sub_ne_zero (phi t) (phi b) hb
+  let r : ZMod C0 := t-(e : ZMod C0)*b
+  have hr : phi r ≠ 0 := by
+    simpa only [r,map_sub,map_mul,map_natCast,nsmul_eq_mul] using hne
+  have hc : (r.val : ZMod p) = phi r := by
+    rw [← map_natCast phi r.val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
+  have hnd : ¬ p ∣ r.val := by
+    intro hd
+    have hz : (r.val : ZMod p) = 0 := (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p r.val).mpr hd
+    exact hr (hc.symm.trans hz)
+  have hpos : 0 < r.val := by
+    by_contra h
+    have hz : r.val = 0 := by omega
+    exact hnd (hz ▸ dvd_zero p)
+  exact ⟨e,r.val,he,hpos,ZMod.val_lt r,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val r,
+    hp.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd hnd⟩
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.ControllerAuxiliaryChoice

+import DiophantineConsistency.ControllerAuxiliaryChoice
+
+/-!
+# Constructing every affine subset residue with one optional Boolean term
+
+The explicit coordinate injection and affine weight formula are structural
+inputs. The Boolean term, cardinality, coordinate target and finite subset
+are constructed here. The actual power-orbit interface is still separate.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.ControllerResidueLift
+
+open ControllerAuxiliaryChoice ControllerOrbitTransport
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- Lift a known small residue to its actual quotient coordinate. -/
+theorem exists_coordinate {C0 T : ℕ} [NeZero C0] [NeZero T]
+    (z : ZMod (C0*T)) (a : ℕ) (ha : a < C0)
+    (hz : ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0) z = (a : ZMod C0)) :
+    ∃ u : ZMod T,
+      z = (a : ZMod (C0*T))+(C0 : ZMod (C0*T))*(u.val : ZMod (C0*T)) := by
+  let phi : ZMod (C0*T) →+* ZMod C0 := ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0)
+  have hc : phi z = (z.val : ZMod C0) := by
+    calc
+      phi z = phi (z.val : ZMod (C0*T)) := congrArg phi (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val z).symm
+      _ = (z.val : ZMod C0) := map_natCast phi z.val
+  have hm : z.val%C0 = a := by
+    have he := congrArg ZMod.val (hc.symm.trans hz)
+    simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha] using he
+  have hq : z.val/C0 < T :=
+    (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (NeZero.pos C0)).mpr (by
+      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using ZMod.val_lt z)
+  refine ⟨((z.val/C0 : ℕ) : ZMod T),?_⟩
+  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hq,← Nat.cast_mul,← Nat.cast_add]
+  rw [← hm,Nat.mod_add_div,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
+
+/-- All target residues are realized by an actual subset and one Boolean
+multiple of b, once the affine coordinate injection is supplied. -/
+theorem exists_subset_boolean_sum {C0 T p : ℕ} [NeZero C0] [NeZero T]
+    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
+    (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hdiv : p ∣ C0) (n : ℕ) (hT : T = p^n) (hCT : C0 < T)
+    (index : ZMod T → α) (hinj : Function.Injective index)
+    (weight : α → ZMod (C0*T))
+    (hw : ∀ z, weight (index z) = 1+(C0 : ZMod (C0*T))*(z.val : ZMod (C0*T)))
+    (t b : ZMod (C0*T))
+    (hb : ZMod.castHom hdiv (ZMod p)
+      (ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0) b) ≠ 0) :
+    ∃ e a : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset α,
+      e ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < a ∧ a < C0 ∧ s.card = a ∧
+      (∑ x ∈ s, weight x)+(e : ZMod (C0*T))*b = t := by
+  let phi : ZMod (C0*T) →+* ZMod C0 := ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right C0 T) (ZMod C0)
+  obtain ⟨e,a,he,hapos,ha,hres,hcop⟩ :=
+    exists_coprime_cardinality hp hdiv (phi t) (phi b) hb n
+  let r := t-(e : ZMod (C0*T))*b
+  have hr : phi r = (a : ZMod C0) := by
+    simpa only [r,map_sub,map_mul,map_natCast] using hres.symm
+  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := exists_coordinate r a ha hr
+  have hcopT : Nat.Coprime a T := by rw [hT]; exact hcop
+  have haT : a ≤ T := by omega
+  refine ⟨e,a,targetSubset index a hcopT u,he,hapos,ha,
+    targetSubset_card index hinj a hcopT haT u,?_⟩
+  rw [targetSubset_modular_sum C0 index hinj weight hw a hcopT haT u,← hu]
+  exact sub_add_cancel t ((e : ZMod (C0*T))*b)
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.ControllerResidueLift

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordClause2011
+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentAdjacency2011
+
+/-!
+# Actual copy and marker masks of a constructed marked word
+
+The marker in cell j records Start at j+s. Its temporal source is therefore
+the Start bit of the current cell. Literal color matching gives the other
+seventeen bit equalities. The normalized tests follow from the actual carry
+equations and derived low resets; no mask or copy equality is assumed.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordCopies2011
+
+open NativeCyclicConvolution NativeBooleanRotation CurrentMasks2011
+  CurrentCellConstruction2011 CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordClause2011
+  CurrentCellTranslation2011 CurrentCellCoordinate2011
+  CurrentReflectedGeometry2011 WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
+
+/-- The actual word, with the separately controlled dummy and the fixed marker sign. -/
+def constructedWord (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ) (s : ℕ) :
+    ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ :=
+  CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N))
+
+omit [NeZero N] in
+theorem constructed_boolean (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s : ℕ) (k : ZMod (N*2011)) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s k ≤ 1 :=
+  word_boolean a dummy _ hd (shiftedStartMarker_boolean a _) k
+
+omit [NeZero N] in
+theorem constructed_support (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s : ℕ) (k : ZMod (N*2011)) (hk : k.val%2011 ∉ lowSupport) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s k = 0 := word_support a dummy _ k hk
+
+/-- Whole-cell translation, with no upper bound or coprimality on s. -/
+theorem base_sub_stride (j : ZMod N) (s : ℕ) :
+    base (j-(s : ZMod N)) = base j-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) := by
+  rw [base_eq_coordinate,coordinate_symm_sub,coe_theta]
+  simp only [wholeShift,Nat.mul_mod,Nat.mod_self,Nat.zero_mul,Nat.zero_mod,Nat.sub_zero]
+  rw [← base_eq_coordinate]
+
+theorem word_shift_at_base (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N) (e : ℕ) (he : e < 2011) :
+    CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker
+      (base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) =
+      if e = 977 then dummy (j-(s : ZMod N))
+      else if e = 1004 then marker (j-(s : ZMod N))
+      else localDigit (a (j-(s : ZMod N))) e := by
+  have hp : base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) =
+      base (j-(s : ZMod N))+(e : ZMod (N*2011)) := by
+    rw [base_sub_stride]
+    ring
+  rw [hp,word_at_base a dummy marker _ e he]
+
+theorem word_shift_data (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy marker : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s : ℕ) (j : ZMod N) (e : ℕ) (he : e < 986) (hd : e ≠ 977) :
+    CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy marker
+      (base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) =
+        localDigit (a (j-(s : ZMod N))) e := by
+  rw [word_shift_at_base a dummy marker s j e (by omega),if_neg hd,
+    if_neg (show e ≠ 1004 by omega)]
+
+theorem south_pair (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ) (s : ℕ)
+    (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) (j : ZMod N) (i : Fin 9) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s (base j+((942+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) =
+      constructedWord a dummy s
+        (base j+((960+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) := by
+  unfold constructedWord
+  rw [word_data a dummy _ j _ (by omega) (by omega),
+    word_shift_data a dummy _ s j _ (by omega) (by omega),
+    localDigit_south _ _ i.isLt,localDigit_north _ _ i.isLt]
+  have hh := ha.temporal j
+  simp only [Int.cast_natCast] at hh
+  rw [hh]
+
+theorem horizontal_pair (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ) (s : ℕ)
+    (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) (j : ZMod N) (i : Fin 8) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s (base j+((969+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) =
+      constructedWord a dummy s
+        (CurrentAdjacency2011.previousCell (base j)+((978+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) := by
+  have hp : CurrentAdjacency2011.previousCell (base j) = base (j-1) := by
+    simpa only [CurrentAdjacency2011.previousCell,Nat.mul_one,Nat.cast_one,Nat.cast_ofNat]
+      using (base_sub_stride j 1).symm
+  unfold constructedWord
+  rw [hp,word_data a dummy _ j _ (by omega) (by omega),
+    word_data a dummy _ (j-1) _ (by omega) (by omega),
+    localDigit_east _ _ i.isLt,localDigit_west _ _ i.isLt,ha.horizontal j]
+
+/-- The temporal source reads m(j-s)=Start((j-s)+s)=Start(j).
+This identity needs neither tile matching nor a Boolean dummy premise. -/
+theorem marker_pair (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ) (s : ℕ)
+    (j : ZMod N) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s
+      (base j+1004-((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) = constructedWord a dummy s (base j) := by
+  unfold constructedWord
+  have h0 := word_at_base a dummy (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N)) j 0 (by decide)
+  simp only [Nat.cast_zero,add_zero,show (0 : ℕ) ≠ 977 by decide,
+    show (0 : ℕ) ≠ 1004 by decide,ite_false,localDigit_origin] at h0
+  rw [h0,show (1004 : ZMod (N*2011)) = ((1004 : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) from rfl,
+    word_shift_at_base a dummy _ s j 1004 (by decide)]
+  simp only [show (1004 : ℕ) ≠ 977 by decide,ite_false,ite_true,
+    shiftedStartMarker,sub_add_cancel]
+  split_ifs with h <;> simp only [h,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.toNat_true,Bool.toNat_false]
+
+/-- In every interior low field both adjacent carries are derived to vanish.
+This exact digit formula does not assume a mask test. -/
+theorem normalized_low_digit (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s : ℕ) (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts (constructedWord a dummy s) (displacement s) k digits)
+    (j : ZMod N) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e ∧ e ≤ 1004) :
+    digits (base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))) =
+      CurrentCarryConstruction2011.raw (constructedWord a dummy s) (displacement s)
+        (base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))) := by
+  have hout := low_carry_zero a dummy _ hd (shiftedStartMarker_boolean a _) _ k digits hf j e he.2
+  have hin := low_carry_zero a dummy _ hd (shiftedStartMarker_boolean a _) _ k digits hf j (e-1) (by omega)
+  have hp : base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011))-1 = base j+((e-1 : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) := by
+    rw [Nat.cast_sub he.1,Nat.cast_one]
+    ring
+  have h := hf.decomposition (base j+(e : ZMod (N*2011)))
+  rw [hp,hin,hout,mul_zero,add_zero,add_zero] at h
+  exact h.symm
+
+theorem south_mask_pass (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s : ℕ) (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a)
+    (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts (constructedWord a dummy s) (displacement s) k digits)
+    (j : ZMod N) (i : Fin 9) :
+    digits (base j+((960+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) &&&
+      CurrentHighDigits2011.maskDigits (base j+((960+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011))) = 0 := by
+  rw [CurrentCopyParity2011.south_mask _ (base_aligned j),Nat.and_comm,Nat.one_and_eq_mod_two,
+    normalized_low_digit a dummy hd s k digits hf j _ (by omega),CurrentCarryConstruction2011.raw,
+    CurrentCopyParity2011.south_convolution _ (constructed_support a dummy s) _ (base_aligned j)]
+  rw [show constructedWord a dummy s = CurrentWordConstruction2011.word a dummy
+    (shiftedStartMarker a (s : ZMod N)) from rfl,
+    rotation_whole a dummy _ hd (shiftedStartMarker_boolean a _)]
+  have hp := south_pair a dummy s ha j i
+  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := reflected_even (constructedWord a dummy s)
+    (base j+((960+i.val : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)))
+  change (_+reflected (constructedWord a dummy s) _+_)%2 = 0
+  unfold constructedWord at hp
+  rw [← hp]
+  omega
+
+theorem horizontal_mask_pass (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
